limitations: HSY land-cover tree classes are clipped by roads and buildings; blank road strips do not prove that overhead canopy is absent.
The separate uncut latvuspeitto product is described by HSY but not present in the retrieved public WFS/WMS capabilities; not claimed to have been obtained.
The image and dated 2024 tree coverage cannot certify present-day clearance, tree trunks, low shrubs, power lines, or dynamic obstacles.
Five visually reviewed additions close specific obvious canopy crossings; other uncertain wooded routes require further registered observations or depth sensing.
Original Gazebo world has no physical trees. Semantic exclusions do not themselves add trees to camera/depth simulation.
